task.title: DisplayLine neutralizes Cc but not Cf: RTL override survives into terminal output
task.description: Found during PR #100's adversarial review; pre-existing (task titles share the hole). core.DisplayLine maps Unicode Cc (control) characters to spaces but passes Cf (format) characters through — U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE survives into show/board terminal output, letting a hostile title or comment body visually reorder the rest of its line (classic RTLO spoofing, e.g. making 'gpj.exe' read as 'exe.jpg' or reordering a refusal message). Comments make this easier to reach than titles since they're long-form collaborative text. Fix direction: extend DisplayLine to neutralize the bidi-control subset of Cf (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E/U+200F) while leaving benign Cf (e.g. ZWJ in emoji) alone — with a test rendering a hostile body and asserting no bidi control reaches the terminal.
